Adversaries may interact with the Windows Registry to gather information about the system, configuration, and installed software.
Adversaries may communicate using application layer protocols to avoid detection/network filtering by blending in with existing traffic.

signature_matches.name: forwarded export
signature_matches.description: executable/pe/export
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: forwarded export
    namespace: executable/pe/export
    authors:
      - ronnie.salomonsen@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    att&ck:
      - Execution::Shared Modules [T1129]
    examples:
      - 76FA734236DAA023444DEC26863401DC
  features:
    - characteristic: forwarded export
